channel.title: MCCPS Payments Blog
channel.description: Straight answers on interchange, pricing models, statements, security, chargebacks and running a lower-cost, faster-paid business.

item.title: How Credit Card Processing Works, Step by Step
item.description: Follow a card payment from tap to deposit: authorization, clearing, settlement, and the parties that touch every sale. A plain-English guide for merchants.

item.title: Interchange Fees Explained
item.description: Interchange is the largest part of card processing cost. Learn who sets it, why it varies by card and sale type, and what you can and cannot control.

item.description: Assessment fees are the small card network charges stacked on every sale. See what they cover, how they are calculated, and where they show up on statements.

item.description: Processor markup is the one part of your card fees that is actually negotiable. Learn how it is built, how to spot it, and what to ask before you sign.

item.title: Your Effective Rate: The Only Number That Matters

item.title: Tiered Pricing: Qualified vs. Non-Qualified
